story.iWant: start the frontend application service automatically
story.soThat: users have access to a complete web interface for the quantitative trading platform
story.tasks:
- [ ] Task 1: Frontend Service Startup Core Functionality (AC: 1, 5) - [ ] Subtask 1.1: Implement Node.js process detection and frontend startup logic - [ ] Subtask 1.2: Configure frontend service startup parameters and environment variables - [ ] Subtask 1.3: Implement process status monitoring and PID management for frontend - [ ] Subtask 1.4: Create frontend startup logging mechanism - [ ] Subtask 1.5: Implement startup timeout and error handling for frontend service - [ ] Subtask 1.6: Implement automatic browser opening with access link generation
- [ ] Task 2: Frontend Application Access Verification (AC: 2) - [ ] Subtask 2.1: Implement frontend accessibility check on localhost:3000 - [ ] Subtask 2.2: Verify frontend page loading and rendering completeness - [ ] Subtask 2.3: Add response time validation for frontend accessibility - [ ] Subtask 2.4: Create frontend status reporting mechanism - [ ] Subtask 2.5: Implement frontend health check retry mechanism
- [ ] Task 3: Frontend-Backend Communication Verification (AC: 3) - [ ] Subtask 3.1: Implement API endpoint connectivity testing (frontend → backend:8000) - [ ] Subtask 3.2: Verify CORS configuration and API request/response flow - [ ] Subtask 3.3: Test data retrieval and display functionality - [ ] Subtask 3.4: Create communication status monitoring - [ ] Subtask 3.5: Implement communication error recovery mechanism
- [ ] Task 4: Static Resource Loading Detection (AC: 4) - [ ] Subtask 4.1: Implement static resource loading verification (CSS, JS, images) - [ ] Subtask 4.2: Detect page rendering completeness and component initialization - [ ] Subtask 4.3: Add resource loading timeout and error handling - [ ] Subtask 4.4: Create resource loading status reporting - [ ] Subtask 4.5: Implement resource loading fallback mechanisms

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Start frontend development server (Next.js/React) and verify process running status 2. Verify frontend application accessibility (http://localhost:3000) 3. Ensure frontend-backend API communication is working properly (Backend:8000 API accessible) 4. Detect static resource loading status and page rendering integrity 5. Generate frontend access link with automatic browser opening support

doc.title: 一键启动脚本 Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: 服务启动序列集成：1. Redis启动 (端口6379) → 等待就绪 (30秒超时) 2. 后端API启动 (端口8000) → 健康检查通过 (60秒超时) 3. 前端应用启动 (端口3000) → 构建完成 (120秒超时)

doc.title: 一键启动脚本 Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: Python 3.11.14+ (LTS) 作为核心引擎，psutil 7.1.3+ 用于进程管理，rich 13.9.4+ 用于CLI界面，requests 2.32.3+ 用于HTTP客户端

doc.title: Backend API Service Startup
doc.snippet: BackendServiceManager 类可用，HealthChecker 类支持端点健康检查，Python 进程检测使用 psutil，API 端点验证模式已建立，ServiceConfigurator 类提供配置验证

constraints.constraint: 遵循 Database → Backend → Frontend 启动序列，确保服务依赖关系
使用 BackendServiceManager 作为模式，保持一致的API和错误处理
文件命名 snake_case，类命名 PascalCase，函数命名 snake_case
使用现有 PortManager 处理 Frontend:3000 端口分配和冲突检测
统一异常格式：{code, message, solution, details}
使用 asyncio 模式进行并发前端操作
前端启动超时 120秒，健康检查间隔 5秒，最大重试 3次
使用 ProgressTracker 并提供 component_name="frontend_startup"
使用结构化日志记录，包含启动进度、错误和状态变化

interface.name: FrontendServiceManager
interface.signature: class FrontendServiceManager: def __init__(self, config: FrontendServiceConfig) -> None

interface.name: FrontendServiceConfig
interface.signature: @dataclass class FrontendServiceConfig: service_name: str = 'frontend', host: str = 'localhost', port: int = 3000

interface.name: start_service
interface.signature: async def start_service(self) -> bool: # 启动前端开发服务器并验证状态

interface.name: check_frontend_accessibility
interface.signature: async def check_frontend_accessibility(self) -> bool: # 验证 localhost:3000 访问性

interface.name: verify_backend_communication
interface.signature: async def verify_backend_communication(self) -> bool: # 测试前端→后端:8000 API通信

interface.name: HealthChecker.check_endpoint
interface.signature: async def check_endpoint(self, url: str) -> HealthCheckResult: # HTTP端点健康检查

interface.name: PortManager.check_port_availability
interface.signature: def check_port_availability(self, port: int) -> bool: # 检查端口可用性

interface.name: ProgressTracker.track_progress
interface.signature: def track_progress(self, component_name: str, progress: int, message: str) -> None: # 跟踪进度

tests.standards: 使用 pytest 和 asyncio 进行异步测试，遵循测试驱动开发(TDD)方法。测试文件命名 test_*.py，测试类命名 Test*，测试方法命名 test_*。使用 Mock 和 AsyncMock 进行依赖隔离，fixture 进行测试数据管理。测试覆盖：服务启动、前端访问性验证、后端通信测试、资源加载检测、错误处理场景。集成测试应包含完整启动流程测试。
tests.locations: one-click-launcher/tests/test_frontend_service.py - 前端服务主要测试文件，one-click-launcher/tests/test_integration.py - 集成测试，one-click-launcher/tests/ - 其他相关测试文件
